wiki00071:
flowchart TD
    A(["Start"]) --> B["Acquire primary Taoist texts for reading"]
    B --> C["Seek out the writings of Chuang-Tzu (Zhuangzi)"]

    C --> D{"Is the reader looking for a more humorous perspective?"}
    D -->|Yes| E["Read 'Zhuangzi Speaks' and 'The Tao Speaks'"]
    D -->|No| F["Consider other Taoist texts"]

    E --> G["Read 'The Tao of Pooh' and 'The Te of Piglet'"]
    F --> G

    G --> H["Search for quality translations of the Tao Te Ching and other Chinese texts"]
    H --> I{"Has a quality translation been found?"}
    I -->|No| H
    I -->|Yes| J["Use the selected translation for study"]

    J --> K["Apply the philosophical principles of Taoism to daily actions"]
    K --> L{"Is the reader applying principles consistently?"}
    L -->|No| K
    L -->|Yes| M["Consider joining a Taoist community"]

    M --> N{"Is the reader interested in joining a community?"}
    N -->|Yes| O["Join the preferred Taoist community"]
    N -->|No| P["Continue individual study and application of Taoism"]

    O --> Q["Achieve peace of mind and body through practice and community"]
    P --> Q

    Q --> R["Result is spiritual and philosophical communion, leading to peace"]
    R --> S["Spread peace to other people and the world"]
    S --> T["Explore Neijia (internal martial arts)"]

    T --> U{"Is the reader interested in physical aspects of Taoism?"}
    U -->|Yes| V["Practice Neijia as a form of physical Taoism"]
    U -->|No| W["Focus on the philosophical aspects of Taoism"]

    V --> X(["End"])
    W --> X

code00268:
flowchart TD
    A(["Start"]) --> B[/"Accept input 'grid' and 'n'"/]
    B --> C["Initialize 'incl' to max(grid[0][0], grid[1][0])"]
    C --> D["Initialize 'excl' to 0"]
    D --> E{"Loop from i = 1 to n - 1"}
    E -->|"Yes"| F["Calculate 'excl_new' as max('excl', 'incl')"]
    F --> G["Update 'incl' to 'excl' + max(grid[0][i], grid[1][i])"]
    G --> H["Update 'excl' to 'excl_new'"]
    H --> E
    E -->|"No"| I[/"Output maximum of 'excl' and 'incl'"/]
    I --> J(["End"])
code00404:
flowchart TD
    A(["Start"]) --> B[/"Receive the array 'arr', the element to find 'x', and the size of the array 'n'"/]
    B --> C["Initialize 'low' to 0"]
    C --> D["Initialize 'high' to 'n - 1'"]
    D --> E["Initialize 'res' to -1"]
    E --> F{"low <= high?"}

    F -->|"Yes"| G["Calculate 'mid' as (low + high) // 2"]
    G --> H{"arr[mid] > x?"}

    H -->|"Yes"| I["Set 'high' to 'mid - 1'"]
    I --> F

    H -->|"No"| J{"arr[mid] < x?"}
    J -->|"Yes"| K["Set 'low' to 'mid + 1'"]
    K --> F

    J -->|"No"| L["Set 'res' to 'mid'"]
    L --> M["Set 'low' to 'mid + 1'"]
    M --> F

    F -->|"No"| N[/"Return the value of 'res', the last position of 'x' in 'arr'"/]
    N --> O(["End"])

wiki00409:
flowchart TD

A(["Start Amitabha Meditation"]) --> B["Find a comfortable seated position"]
B --> C["Place hands in the lap or on the legs"]
C --> D["Simulate walking motion with feet"]
D --> E["Awareness of grounding with the earth"]
E --> F["Think 'A-Mi-Ta-Bha' mantra focused in the feet"]
F --> G["Activation of feet chakra"]
G --> H["Look to the left and right"]
H --> I["Focus on body and repeat 'A-Mi-Ta-Bha'"]
I --> J["Body filled with energy, strength, and happiness"]
J --> K["Say 'Om inner wisdom, guide me'"]
K --> L{"Imagined connection with Buddha Amitabha?"}
L -->|No| K
L -->|Yes| M["Proceed with visualization"]
M --> N["Sense of guidance and help"]
N --> O["Express wish for happiness for all"]
O --> P["Positive intentions sent to universe"]
P --> Q["Reflect on positives in life"]
Q --> R["Recognition of life's fullness"]
R --> S["Put hands together in front of belly"]
S --> T["Visualize as Buddha Amitabha and speak affirmations"]
T --> U["Embodiment of Buddha Amitabha's qualities"]
U --> V["Remain in a state of calm and rest"]
V --> W["Affirm Buddha Amitabha leads through wisdom and love"]
W --> X["Expectation of guidance towards life in light"]
X --> Y["Say 'Amitabha' mantra ten times"]
Y --> Z{"Sensed energy flow of Buddha Amitabha?"}
Z -->|No| Y
Z -->|Yes| AA["Acknowledge energy flow"]
AA --> AB(["End Amitabha Meditation"])
code00412:
flowchart TD
    A(["Start"]) --> B[/"Accept `input_string`"/]
    B --> C["Initialize `lowercase_count` to 0"]
    C --> D["Set index `i` to 0"]
    D --> E{"Is `i` less than the length of `input_string`?"}
    E -->|"Yes"| F["Set `current_char` to character at `input_string[i]`"]
    E -->|"No"| O[/"Output `lowercase_count`"/] --> P(["End"])
    F --> G{"Is `current_char` a lowercase letter?"}
    G -->|"Yes"| H["Increment `lowercase_count` by 1"]
    G -->|"No"| I["Move to next character"]
    H --> J["Increment `i` by 1"]
    I --> J
    J --> E
